# LRM 5.4.3: "The expression V(<a>) is invalid for ports and nets, where V is a
# potential access function."  A port access function reads the FLOW into the
# port and nothing else.  (The .va comment cites 4.4.2, which gives the access
# function grammar; 5.4.3 is where the prohibition itself is stated.)

potential access function
